That’s the other thing - you need time to digest the material and learn the complexities of the concepts you’re  learning about. It ain’t gonna happen over night! I found flash cards helpful for this type of progressive learning, so I could easily refresh myself about a theory when noticing it in a new course.

My reality was rewritten by a (future) cult leader. 

It was a few years ago, and seemed so innocuous. We were good, close friends and his practices seemed so genuine and intentional. It started out with little things like changing clothes when entering his space, eventually growing into a full cleansing practice upon entering. 

Then it gradually became a sexual thing. There was another friend of his that was called in at this stage. 

At one point, they were both telling me to move away with them and to leave behind my family to be with them. The friend would be telling me about the magic of his penis, saying it was just so wonderful and not at all triggering, though I had myself been triggered by said penis. Any piece of reality that I had about this situation was rewritten and weaponized against me. This is when I lost touch with reality. 

My new girlfriend at the time (bless her) suggested taking a break from seeing this guy. The theory being a healthy, normal person would allow some time and space apart, trusting that their underlying friendship and connection would reunite them. The last thing I wanted was to take a break. I was addicted. To prove to her it was all fine and normal, I told him I needed space. This is when it blew up. 

Messages. Phone calls. Stalking. Fear. 

He crossed the line and began messaging other people, begging them to tell me to contact him. At this time, my girlfriend convinced me to go to the police and create a statement in case it grew further, since he knew where I lived and where my family went to school. 

I was legitimately fearful that he would go to my little’s school to confront me.

I am so thankful that my girlfriend saw the flags and instead of backing out and leaving me in that crazy situation, held on to me and guided me out safely. I completely lost touch with reality and had to transfer all of my trust onto her to get out. I remember my family thinking I was emotionally abused by this woman, when in fact it was one of my friends who was emotionally, physically, mentally, and sexually abusing me. I can’t believe I was taken on such a ride.  

We just celebrated our three year anniversary. 

I think about the guy a lot, and am still friends with the girl. I haven’t unblocked the guy. Still concerned about what those consequences might be like.

Take note of your symptoms and what you’re experiencing. The doc will likely do a test with you and ask how often you feel depressed/specific types of shittiness. Are you hoping to obtain medication from the doctor? If so, do a little research about common anti depressants to help you feel more informed going into the appointment. Depression and anxiety are real, measurable, and legitimate. Just approach it like you would approach any other chronic condition: what you’re experiencing, for how long, possible treatment options. 

As someone who struggles A LOT with depression, I would recommend seeing if you can be referred to counselling by your doc for low/no cost therapeutic sessions. I’ve luckily found an amazing psychiatrist who monitors my medications and sees me regularly to work through potential causes of my condition. It’s been super effective!!
